verification_instructions: 1. Log in to MongoDB Atlas: https://cloud.mongodb.com/
2. Under Database Deployments, click on your Cluster -> 'Atlas Search' tab (or 'Search' in left navigation).
3. Click 'Create Search Index' and choose 'Atlas Vector Search' (JSON Editor).
5. Set Index Name to exactly: vector_index
6. Paste the 'definition' object below into the editor.
7. Click 'Next' and then 'Create Vector Search Index'.
8. Status verification: Watch the Status column transition from 'Initializing' / 'Initial Sync' to 'READY' (green checkmark). Once READY, $vectorSearch pipeline queries are active.
